_note: Stillwater Major Arcana meaning base for Vera, ENGLISH. Upright only. Faithful natural translation of card-meanings.json (Thai base); same ids, files and fields, no added meanings. AI must interpret only from these fields plus the question; never invent other card meanings. DRAFT 2026-10-09, to be reviewed by Palm.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.core: beginnings, stepping away from the familiar, risk, possibility
cards.love: A relationship that has just begun, or one you want to start again; an open heart, but no guarantees yet
cards.work: A new opportunity, trying an unfamiliar path, without a complete plan yet
cards.caution: jumping without looking where you'll land, being careless because you want to escape what you had
cards.advice: You can step forward, but take a small step and know what you're risking

cards.name: The Magician
cards.core: willpower, ability, taking action, using what you already have to make something happen
cards.love: Say clearly what you mean; your own intention shapes a lot of where this relationship goes
cards.work: You already have the tools; the only thing missing is action
cards.caution: talking better than doing, or using charm to cover the truth
cards.advice: Pick one thing and act on it with what you have right now

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.core: what hasn't been revealed yet, intuition, silence, a truth that needs time to surface
cards.love: Something hasn't been said yet; the other person, or you, are still holding something back
cards.work: The information isn't complete yet; don't judge from what you see on the surface
cards.caution: guessing what someone thinks and then believing it as fact
cards.advice: Listen to your deeper feelings, and wait for the facts to show before you decide

cards.name: The Empress
cards.core: growth, nurturing, abundance, something taking shape
cards.love: Warmth and caring for each other; a relationship that can grow if it gets attention
cards.work: Work that is slowly starting to bear fruit; creativity
cards.caution: looking after others until you forget yourself, or being so kind that you get taken advantage of
cards.advice: Give time and care to what you want to grow, including yourself

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.core: structure, control, responsibility, stability
cards.love: A need for clarity and stability; a question of who sets the pace
cards.work: Systems, rules, people in authority, long-term planning
cards.caution: being too rigid, controlling until the other person feels boxed in
cards.advice: Set clear boundaries and take responsibility for your own part

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.core: rules, systems, beliefs, guidance, established ways of doing things
cards.love: Expectations from family or society; a serious relationship that follows tradition
cards.work: Organisations, procedures, learning from people who know
cards.caution: doing what others say until you stop asking your own heart
cards.advice: Ask someone experienced for guidance, then make your own choice with a clear head

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.core: choice, relationship, decision, something that has to be chosen with both your heart and the truth
cards.love: The attraction is real, but there is a choice that asks you to be honest with your heart
cards.work: A crossroads where you choose by the values you hold
cards.caution: choosing to please someone else, or refusing to choose at all
cards.advice: Choose the path that still lets you be yourself

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.core: movement, determination, steering your direction, moving forward
cards.love: Someone has to be brave enough to move; the relationship moves when the intention is clear
cards.work: You can move forward if you rein in the forces pulling you in different directions
cards.caution: pushing on stubbornly, wanting to win so much you forget where you're going
cards.advice: Set a clear direction, then keep going without getting distracted

cards.name: Strength
cards.core: strength, steadying your emotions, patience, inner power
cards.love: Gentleness and patience help far more than pressure
cards.work: You get through this by staying calm and consistent
cards.caution: being patient until you're bottling things up, or forcing yourself to be strong alone
cards.advice: Meet what's hard with a calm, gentle heart

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.core: stepping back, looking for answers within, clarity, quiet
cards.love: A period of distance; time alone to find out what you really want
cards.work: Think deeply, work quietly, study until things are clear
cards.caution: withdrawing until you're cut off, or going round in circles without acting
cards.advice: Step back and listen to yourself for a while, then decide

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.core: change, cycles, turning points, timing that is already in motion
cards.love: The situation is turning; what has been stuck may change direction
cards.work: The timing is shifting; opportunities come and go quickly
cards.caution: leaving everything to fate and doing nothing
cards.advice: Watch the timing, and be ready to move when it arrives

cards.name: Justice
cards.core: truth, balance, the consequences of decisions, clarity
cards.love: Fairness in the relationship: who gives, who receives, and whether it's equal
cards.work: Contracts, judgements, the results of what you've done
cards.caution: judging others without looking at your own part
cards.advice: Look at the truth directly and accept the consequences of your choices

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.core: pausing, a new perspective, letting something go, changing how you look at things
cards.love: Things are on hold; the relationship needs to be seen from another angle
cards.work: Work has stalled; this is a time you can't force, and it asks you to think differently
cards.caution: sacrificing until you become the victim, or waiting with no end in sight
cards.advice: Stop pushing for now, and try looking from an angle you've never looked from

cards.name: Death
cards.core: endings, transition, cutting away the old to make way for the new
cards.love: Some pattern in the relationship has to end; it doesn't always mean a breakup
cards.work: Closing an old chapter; a change of job or of the way you work
cards.caution: holding on to something that has already ended
cards.advice: Let go of what has run its course to make room for something new (never read as literal death)

cards.name: Temperance
cards.core: rebalancing, taking things step by step, bringing different things together so they fit
cards.love: Moving toward each other, finding the right balance, slow healing
cards.work: Blending two approaches so they fit; keeping at it steadily and patiently
cards.caution: compromising until you have no ground of your own
cards.advice: Find the right balance and give the process time

cards.name: The Devil
cards.core: bonds, attachment, a strong pull, patterns that are hard to break free from
cards.love: An infatuation or attachment that keeps you from being free; an old pattern repeating
cards.work: Stuck because of money, fear, or commitments you don't want to be in
cards.caution: telling yourself you have no choice when you do
cards.advice: See clearly what is holding you, then start loosening it from the smallest point

cards.name: The Tower
cards.core: sudden change, a truth coming out, the collapse of what wasn't stable
cards.love: Some truth comes to the surface; what was built on shaky ground is shaken
cards.work: Change you didn't see coming; the old plan no longer works
cards.caution: panicking and making drastic decisions
cards.advice: Accept the truth that has come out, then rebuild on firmer ground than before

cards.name: The Star
cards.core: hope, recovery, faith in the future, calm after chaos
cards.love: The heart is slowly healing; a relationship that is sincere and open
cards.work: Inspiration comes back; long-term goals become clearer
cards.caution: hoping without acting
cards.advice: Let your heart recover, then slowly follow what still gives you hope

cards.name: The Moon
cards.core: uncertainty, what can't be seen clearly yet, fear, an incomplete picture
cards.love: Ambiguity, reading things into it, or something that isn't straightforward
cards.work: Confusing information; don't make a big decision yet
cards.caution: letting fear write the story instead of the facts
cards.advice: Separate what is fact from what is fear

cards.name: The Sun
cards.core: clarity, openness, success, vitality
cards.love: A relationship that is clear and warm; sincerity you can see
cards.work: Your work gets noticed; success you can actually touch
cards.caution: being so confident you overlook the details
cards.advice: Be open and direct, and let yourself receive good things

cards.name: Judgement
cards.core: awakening, decision, something from the past returning, a call to choose
cards.love: An old story or an old person comes back to be looked at again; it's time for a real decision
cards.work: Taking an honest look at yourself; a call to step up to the next level
cards.caution: judging yourself too harshly, or running from the decision
cards.advice: Look back honestly, then answer what your heart already knows

cards.name: The World
cards.core: completing a cycle, wholeness, closing one chapter and entering another
cards.love: The relationship reaches a point where it settles, or a complete and whole close
cards.work: Work completed full circle, ready for a new chapter
cards.caution: refusing to close the chapter because you're afraid to start again
cards.advice: Accept that this chapter is complete, and move on with what you've learned
